name: Bubble and Squeak
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: Various cooked vegetables (e.g. potatoes, cabbage, carrots, peas, and/or Brussels sprouts)

steps: Fry the chopped onion in fat or oil.
Chop the vegetables, and add to the pan.

Cook over a medium heat till the underside is golden brown and crispy, then turn it, scraping the crispy bits into the mix. Repeat the turning and scraping a few times until browned and cooked through.

culture.text: Bubble and squeak is a traditional English vegetable dish made from the leftover vegetables from a Sunday roast. The name is derived from the sound the dish makes while cooking.
